title: School day round 2 - AI helper and the 21 Oct fixes

seats.persona: School admin, 45, desktop in the morning and phone after; impatient with extra taps; checks money twice.
Front-office clerk, Hindi first but reads English menus; busy counter, interrupted often; phone and old PC.
School accountant, 50s, precise, Excel habits; totals must tie out to the rupee; desktop.
Fee collector at the gate, Hindi only, budget Android phone, one thumb, parents queuing.
Second fee collector, young and fast; tries shortcuts and double-taps when the network is slow.
Academic coordinator, ex-maths teacher; arranges cover and tracks notes; laptop and phone.
Exam coordinator; checks marks counts against the paper registers; distrusts automatic totals.
Trustee who looks in once a week on a tablet; should see everything and change nothing.
Class 4 class teacher, science, Hindi only, 50s; large text on an old phone; types with one finger.
Class 11 Arts class teacher, English; applies for leave today; mixes Hindi and English; quick on a phone.
Hindi and sports teacher with no class of their own; covers periods often; phone only, mostly outdoors.
Class 12 Arts class teacher with a very full timetable; wants attendance done in under a minute.
Class 10 class teacher, maths, board year; enters marks carefully and checks every total.
Class 11 Science class teacher, physics; at ease with apps; tries decimals, blanks and the Back button.
Primary teacher, Classes 2 and 3, Hindi only; first smartphone this year; afraid of the wrong button.
Class 8 class teacher; writes many notes about children and wants the sensitive ones private.
Class 12 Commerce class teacher; parents phone often about attendance; lives in WhatsApp.
Class 5 class teacher, Hindi; report cards matter most; wants remarks to sound like their own words.
Class 12 Science class teacher and sports; on the ground half the day; uses the app in short bursts.
Class 9 class teacher, accountancy and maths; methodical; reopens and corrects marks and attendance.
Primary maths and EVS teacher with no class of their own; many periods; often asked to cover.
Sanskrit and Hindi teacher, no class; checks notebooks; reads English but thinks in Hindi.
Class 11 Commerce class teacher, economics; slow mobile data; does marks late in the evening.
Class 7 class teacher, robotics and computers; hunts for bugs on purpose; refreshes mid-save.
Teacher with a profile but no periods yet; Hindi only; wants to know what to do on day one.
Chemistry and science subject teacher, no class; borrows other classes' periods for practicals.
Brand-new teacher on the first day, nothing assigned; reads every word; asks the app for help.
New part-time teacher, nothing assigned, desktop only; expects the app to say why it is empty.

waves.name: 1 Morning desk
waves.note: Admin does 07:30 and 07:45 only, and gives the cover to Smoke teacher 3 if the app offers that teacher. Teacher 2 takes leave; teacher 3 does the 07:50 cover plan, then a teacher's day.

waves.name: 2 Registers, Hindi
waves.note: A full teacher's day: attendance, marks, notes, remarks.

waves.name: 5 Office and fee desk
waves.note: Office does 08:30 and 12:30 and sends its tasks to the class teachers of Class 9, Class 11 Commerce and Class 7 (Smoke teachers 12, 15, 16), who answer them in waves 6 and 7. Collectors post amounts of Rs 1-10 only.

waves.name: 6 Accounts
waves.note: Accountant requests a reversal of a wave 5 receipt, then previews day close at 15:00 (never closes). Teachers 12 and 15 answer the office's task.

waves.name: 7 Decisions and exams
waves.note: Admin does 10:00 (the reversal from wave 6) and 13:30. Exam compares counts with what waves 2-4 and 6 saved.

waves.name: 8 Coordination
waves.note: Academic checks that no Only me note from waves 2-7 is visible.

waves.name: 10 Oversight
waves.note: Then the scripted sweep (npm run smoke:sweep) covers the 15:30 every-screen step, and a developer agent groups the findings.
